title: SecReason: Vulnerability Detection and In-Stream Self-Repair for LLM Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.14453v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) may introduce security vulnerabilities into generated code, which can persist into production when verification focuses on functional correctness. Existing defenses act before, during, or after generation, but none inspects the code during generation. Security prompts and retrieved security knowledge act before any code exists, constrained decoding limits token choices but cannot guide repair, and post-hoc repair must regenerate the full response. Reasoning LLMs draft code early in their streamed chain of thought, and in this pre-delivery window the code exists only inside the reasoning stream. We present SecReason, an in-stream defense that monitors this window. Dual-track incremental scanning applies security rules, checking each statement as it is emitted and tracing dataflows across the accumulated code. translated_title: SecReason：面向大语言模型代码生成的漏洞检测与流内自修复
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）生成的代码可能引入安全漏洞，当验证仅关注功能正确性时，这些漏洞可能会持续存在于生产环境中。现有的防御机制在生成之前、生成期间或生成之后发挥作用，但没有一种能在代码生成的过程中对代码进行检查。安全提示词和检索到的安全知识在任何代码出现之前就已起作用，受限解码限制了 token 的选择但无法引导修复，而事后修复必须重新生成完整的响应。推理型大语言模型在其流式思维链的早期阶段起草代码，在这个交付前的窗口期内，代码仅存在于推理流中。我们提出 SecReason，一种监控该窗口的流内防御机制。双轨增量扫描应用安全规则，在每条语句被输出时进行检查，并追踪累积代码中的数据流。当安全规则触发时，SecReason 会中断生成，插入流内警告，并……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出SecReason，一种针对推理型大语言模型代码生成的流内防御机制，通过双轨增量扫描在流式思维链中实时检测安全漏洞并进行自修复。
en_tdlr: SecReason is an in-stream defense for LLM code generation that monitors the reasoning stream via dual-track incremental scanning to detect security vulnerabilities in real time and enable self-repair before code delivery.
